````{python}
# importing portfolio container from data.py
from data import portfolio

# importing display tools for rendering markdown in quarto
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

# iterating over portfolio — works because Portfolio implements __iter__
# calling render_markdown() on each project — polymorphism in action
# each subclass renders differently: DashboardProject adds iframe, VisualProject adds images
for project in portfolio:
    display(Markdown(project.render_markdown()))
````
